title: Marketing page with supplied proof
instruction: Create a landing page for Acme insulated bottles using our supplied brief and proof.

knownFacts.proof: Acme lab sample: 8 of 10 bottles stayed below 10°C for 6 hours at 22°C ambient; synthetic demonstration only.

answerBank.answer: Commuters who bring a cold drink to work.
Choose a size and request product information.
Use only supplied proof; the inquiry is a local demonstration.
Show the practical commute story before technical details.

primaryTask.goal: Understand the bottle offer and supported claims, compare the two sizes, and reach the sample inquiry form with the chosen size.
steps: Read the specific use and benefits
Find the test conditions behind the temperature claim
Reach an inquiry form with the chosen size preserved

forbiddenRegressions: No invented testimonials, customers or certifications
